no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Company pivoted from ophthalmic pharma (formerly Eyenovia) to a Hyperliquid HYPE crypto-treasury and DeFi business. The only remaining clinical-stage asset is the Optejet User Filled Device (Optejet UFD), a topical ophthalmic liquid delivery device — not a drug. Per the FY2025 10-K, in Q1 2026 the company executed a non-binding Letter of Intent to monetize the Optejet UFD, with closing expected in Q2 2026. No active P1/P2/P3 drug trials are sponsored by the issuer.
